shots.line: What would happen if you were born under the ocean in 2200?
shots.environment: round nursery porthole in a seafloor dome, deep blue water outside, soft teal night-lights
shots.action: newborn avatar in a padded crib pod opens its button eyes as a huge manta ray glides past the porthole; a small red diamond kite hangs folded on the crib rail

shots.line: Day one. You're born a hundred metres underwater.
shots.environment: cluster of glowing domes on the dark-blue seafloor 100 m down, tube walkways, fish schools, faint light from far above
shots.action: inside the nearest lit dome window a parent lifts the swaddled newborn while a school of fish swirls past outside

shots.line: The air is helium. Your first cry is a squeak.
shots.environment: nursery inside the dome, warm teal lamps, pressure gauge reading 11 atm on the wall
shots.action: the newborn in a parent's arms opens its mouth to cry and two nurses behind cover their mouths, giggling

shots.line: From the surface, your grandparents send a red kite.
shots.environment: nursery, a small pressure-lock delivery hatch in the wall
shots.action: a parent unwraps a bright red diamond kite from a delivery canister and holds it above the crib; the newborn reaches for its tail
shots.regenerated: v2: re-framed (QC v1 shot-mix / weakest scene)

shots.line: Year six. Red is the first colour the ocean swallows.
shots.environment: dome classroom with a giant round window onto blue water, little desks, cool white light
shots.action: the six-year-old avatar presses the red kite against the big window, the blue water beyond it

shots.line: Outside the window, your kite turns grey.
shots.environment: open water just outside the dome, everything tinted deep blue
shots.action: the child in a small dive suit swims out holding the kite, which looks dull grey-blue in the water; the child frowns at it
shots.regenerated: v2: re-framed (QC v1 shot-mix / weakest scene)

shots.line: At school, sun lamps keep your bones strong.
shots.environment: classroom under rows of glowing violet-white sun lamps, kids in tinted goggles
shots.action: a row of kids in goggles bask under glowing lamps; the avatar in the middle stretches its arms like a sunbather

shots.line: Even the strictest teacher sounds like a cartoon.
shots.environment: classroom, a stern tall teacher at the front
shots.action: the stern teacher speaks and the avatar and classmates burst into laughter, the avatar covering its mouth

shots.line: Year fifteen. You visit the surface for the first time.
shots.environment: lift capsule bay, a round steel capsule with a porthole, cables rising into the dark water above, warm work lights
shots.action: the teen avatar climbs into the capsule clutching the folded red kite, glancing up the cable into the dark
shots.regenerated: v2: re-framed (QC v1 shot-mix / weakest scene)

shots.line: First, four days sealed in a decompression chamber.
shots.environment: cramped round decompression chamber, bunk, gauge on the wall
shots.action: the bored teen lies on a bunk and scratches a fourth tally mark on the wall as a gauge needle creeps down

shots.line: The hatch opens. Your voice drops low.
shots.environment: chamber hatch swinging open onto blinding daylight
shots.action: the hatch swings open and bright daylight floods the teen's face; it squints and its button eyes go wide

shots.line: The sky has no ceiling.
shots.keyframe_reason: composition: tiny teen on a floating deck under a vast open sky (lighting flip)
shots.environment: floating platform deck on a sparkling sea, enormous bright blue sky with towering white clouds, golden afternoon sun
shots.action: the tiny teen avatar stands at the deck rail and slowly tilts its head back to take in the endless sky

shots.line: For one windy afternoon, your kite flies red.
shots.environment: floating platform deck, bright sky, wind
shots.action: the teen runs along the deck and the vivid red kite leaps into the wind, tail snapping, against the blue sky
shots.regenerated: v2: re-framed (QC v1 shot-mix / weakest scene)

shots.line: Year twenty-two. A hurricane up top rips the power cables loose.
shots.keyframe_reason: chapter 4 opener: control room + storm monitor
shots.environment: dome control room under red emergency light, a large monitor showing a hurricane and snapping power cables
shots.action: the adult avatar grips the console as the monitor shows giant waves snapping the floating power cables

shots.line: The domes go dark. The pumps slow down.
shots.environment: the seafloor city from outside, dome lights going out one by one
shots.action: dome lights blink out one by one across the city until only the avatar's flashlight glows in one window

shots.line: Then you remember how hard your kite pulled.
shots.environment: dark quarters lit by a flashlight
shots.action: the avatar's hands lift the faded old red kite off a shelf in the flashlight beam

shots.line: You tie it in the deep current outside.
shots.environment: outside the dome in dark blue water, a dome strut, drifting particles in a strong current
shots.action: the avatar in a dive suit and headlamp ties the kite line to a dome strut; the kite unfurls in the current
shots.regenerated: v2: re-framed (QC v1 shot-mix / weakest scene)

shots.line: It pulls. Hard.
shots.environment: a small spinning generator hub on the dome strut, one dome lamp beside it
shots.action: the kite line snaps taut, a small generator hub spins up and the lamp beside the avatar flickers on, lighting its wide button eyes
shots.regenerated: v2: re-framed (QC v1 shot-mix / weakest scene)

shots.line: Year thirty. Fifty giant kites now fly beneath the city.
shots.environment: below the city, rows of giant red underwater kites on tethers sweeping figure-eights, lit by floodlights
shots.action: the adult avatar stands on a lit lookout platform as giant red kites sweep slow figure-eights below

shots.line: They never land, never stop.
shots.environment: open water beside a giant red underwater kite
shots.action: the avatar pilots a small bubble-canopy sub alongside a giant red kite as it sweeps past

shots.line: Every light in every dome runs on them.
shots.environment: the whole seafloor city glowing warmly, walkways lit
shots.action: the avatar walks a lit tube walkway as dome after dome glows warm around it

shots.line: Kids still squeak your name.
shots.environment: busy dome corridor with children
shots.action: a group of kids run past waving and laughing at the avatar, who waves back with a grin

shots.line: You didn't need the sky. The ocean had wind all along.
shots.keyframe_reason: payoff frame: old kite + giant kite callback (xhigh)
shots.environment: big round dome window, warm interior light, deep blue water outside
shots.action: the avatar holds the small faded red kite at the window as a giant glowing red kite sweeps past outside
shots.regenerated: v2: re-framed (QC v1 shot-mix / weakest scene)
